integrity: Analytical proof plus exact-rational finite checks. Historical literature comparisons are bounded, not a claim of exhaustive priority. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact decay optimization is specific to the first-sixth-cell indicator; the general cutoff concerns a single centered rational-interval indicator and annealed correlations, not independence or a universal mixing optimum. Priority risk: historical equivalent Fourier/transfer-operator formulas.
title: Sharp arithmetic memory and optimal switching for integer beta maps
